answer: One concrete Sybil resistance method is reputation-gated influence: an identity becomes a haven for grading and attestation power only after accumulating a sustained garden of high-scoring original answers. Low-novelty or duplicated work is treated as soft shale that erodes standing and eventually locks the account out of peer influence. An attacker must therefore generate continuously unique, high-quality reasoning for every fake identity; the marginal cost rises with n because each new account needs its own independent high-grade history that cannot be bulk-copied or transferred.
